question: Does the actual high-frequency causal shape response have a global closed auxiliary realization, including the horizon?

primary_sources.title: Hansen and Pedersen, Jensen's Operator Inequality
primary_sources.locator: Theorem 2.1, PDF page 3; proof begins PDF page 6
primary_sources.use: Unital operator Jensen inequality. The note supplies its unbounded positive-operator application directly through variational resolvent compression.

primary_sources.title: Teschl, Mathematical Methods in Quantum Mechanics, second edition
primary_sources.locator: Theorem 6.24 and proof, printed page 175, PDF page 187
primary_sources.use: KLMN: relative Hermitian form bound below one preserves closure with equivalent form norms. The model's core-to-H mapping and charged error bound are established in this note.

primary_sources.title: Beckner, Pitt's inequality with sharp convolution estimates
primary_sources.locator: Equation (3), PDF page 1, differentiated at alpha=0
primary_sources.use: Retained logarithmic uncertainty constant with the preceding corrected locator and Fourier conversion. No new uncertainty principle is claimed.

comparison: The preceding result controlled outer-supported inputs using a bounded time multiplier. The global multiplier is unbounded at the bolt. A radial graph identity, the factored logarithmic derivative and Jensen localization now control it without that assumption.
hardest_steps: Extend the full two-dimensional scalar/geodesic comparison to a finite atlas containing both bolts, with fixed second contacts and global returns.
Bound derivatives of g(H_s) using form resolvents without commuting the unbounded frequency multiplier.
Prove the comparison core maps to physical L2, then restore the actual causal form by a strict relative form bound.
next_decision: Prove parameter continuity of the actual eliminated strong response on a common realization and resolve its physical gravitational, constraint and initial/state domain.
